Proposition
[uniqueness for F-entropy] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Proposition 7.1\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals For fixed $g$, there is a unique minimizer $\bar f$ of ${\mathcal F}(g,f)$ subject to $\int _Me^{-f}dV=1$.
Proof

\sketch With $\Phi =e^{-f/2}$,

\begin{equation} {\mathcal F}=\int _M(4|\nabla \Phi |^2+R\Phi ^2)dV =\int _M\Phi (-4\triangle \Phi +R\Phi )dV,qquad\int _M\Phi ^2dV=1. \end{equation}

Thus the minimum is the lowest eigenvalue of $-4\triangle +R$, whose normalized positive eigenfunction is unique \cite[Chapter XIII.12]{Reed-Simon}.

□
